source: Single home for f-plancheck seats. Edit this file to change the pool. plancheck-pick.mjs, plancheck-console.html, and plancheck-dispatch.mjs read it. Every seat runs at high reasoning. Claude-family models are never OpenRouter rows (roster rule since 2026-09-02) — the Claude door is the claude CLI. Host family and declared Player family are greyed/refused at pick time.

picker.note: HTML one-shot picker when the repo has no standing choice, or on request (Law A port). Count 1-5, then seats. Host + Player families greyed and refused server-side. Same-vendor seats refused. Effort is always high. Pick file is one-use.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.blurb: OpenAI flagship for long-horizon analysis, software engineering, and agentic work. Reached headless via the codex CLI on the operator's ChatGPT subscription. Row id stays `sol` so existing --player/--host keywords still resolve.
models.note: codex exec -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort="high" --sandbox read-only --skip-git-repo-check -   |   $0 (ChatGPT subscription). Codex default at the roster snapshot was gpt-6-astra (codex-cli 0.154.0); check yours with codex --version. --ignore-user-config removed 2026-09-23: it discarded ~/.codex/config.toml's global sandbox = "elevated", which is what permits CreateProcess on Windows, so with the flag the seat could reach the network but read nothing. The seat now inherits the operator's ~/.codex/config.toml (model, effort, MCP servers, hooks, plugins) — less hermetic than the other doors.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.blurb: Anthropic's flagship. Reached headless via the claude CLI on the operator's Claude subscription. Never an OpenRouter row (roster rule since 2026-09-02).
models.note: claude -p --model claude-opus-5 --effort high --permission-mode plan …   |   $0 (Claude subscription). Greyed when Claude hosts or is the Player.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.blurb: xAI flagship with adversarial critique and independent verification skills. Reached headless via the grok CLI on the operator's grok.com login.
models.note: grok --prompt-file … --output-format json --permission-mode plan --reasoning-effort high --no-subagents -m grok-4.6   |   $0 (grok.com login). `grok models` lists grok-4.6 (default) and grok-4.5.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.blurb: Moonshot AI's 2.8T-parameter open-weight multimodal reasoner — coding, knowledge work, and long-horizon agentic workflows over large repositories.
models.note: OpenRouter id moonshotai/kimi-k3. Dispatched headless via pi at thinking high: pi -p … --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3 --thinking high.
